commands.environment: Repository devenv e2e Playwright runtime; LIFIC_BIN defaults to target/debug/lific

commands.notes: Recheck after attaching thread fixtures before rendering and awaiting render settlement; same five leaf failures.

checkpoint: Current executable fixture plus live production JS/CSS. Subsequent production visual changes require a fresh browser checkpoint.
reviewCorrections: Generation staleness observes actual palette mount/popstate and searchCurrent, rather than a synthesized route increment.
Installed project icons require a rendered SVG/img child and reject serialized icon tokens.
Reference-number adapter extracts the current production match expression.
Original mobile Shift+Tab, rename keyboard, group movement, and native popup assertions remain active.
Mermaid thread fixtures attach to the document before invoking actual rendering and wait for asynchronous settlement.
